attributes.role: Machine Learning Engineer | Generative AI | Data Engineering | Computer Engineering | Communications
attributes.personal_statement:
As a dedicated Machine Learning Engineer, I specialize in building, testing, and deploying cutting-edge machine learning models. My role involves close collaboration with Data Scientists and Senior Engineers to pre-process data, implement algorithms, and ensure that our solutions are both accurate and effective.

With a strong proficiency in debugging and optimizing models, I am committed to delivering high-quality machine-learning solutions that meet diverse application needs. I stay current with the latest industry developments to continuously enhance approaches and techniques, driving innovation and excellence in every project I undertake.

attributes.summary:
Led the development and execution of proposals and projects ranging from small to large-scale, coordinating cross-functional teams, mentoring associates and interns, and refining project workflows to ensure timely delivery and alignment with strategic goals. Implemented and managed comprehensive office technology infrastructure, including configuring devices, setting up networks, and providing technical support to enhance operational efficiency.

Directed the management of digital assets, overseeing the company’s website, social media channels, and newsletters to maintain a strong online presence and engage with stakeholders effectively. Conducted detailed research on company strategy, competitor dynamics, and stakeholder needs, providing actionable insights that informed strategic decisions and contributed to successful project outcomes.

Supervised interns and associates in completing diverse administrative tasks, from managing complex schedules to preparing confidential documents, and co-led the company’s regulatory and statutory affiliations to uphold legal and industry standards.

attributes.role: Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Data Engineering Trainee
attributes.summary:
Built Precision RAG Prompt Tuning system, focused on enhancing the performance of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model through advanced prompt tuning techniques. 

Key responsibilities included:
Developed an automatic prompt generation system to automatically generate prompts based on user queries and specific scenarios.

Implemented mechanisms to fetch and extract relevant information from web documents, blogs, and PDF data.

Utilized the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model to generate precise and contextually relevant responses.

Generated evaluation data by comparing generated responses with ground truth responses to assess and refine model performance.
